design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (order_returns_care) — late expedited order with a received error return and a kept damaged unit. Round 2 (rework of audits/policy_task/order_returns_care).

[Step 0 — snapshot, scope, draw]
Occupied by task 0: order_ext_freight_missed_appointment_refund + order_ext_freight_rebooked_redelivery_fee and their tools (freight order). Claimed here, the remaining space (nothing unclaimed afterwards): order_ext_error_return_refund (agent, order_return_refund, refund_error_return_9d87fcb3), order_ext_returnless_damage_credit (user, order_damage_credit, accept_returnless_damage_refund_2d82d69e), order_ext_late_delivery_fee_refund (agent, order_fee_refund of a non-redelivery fulfillment fee, refund_order_fulfillment_fee_03b15c6d).
Trigger note: order_return_refund and order_damage_credit declare member:member_points_reverse with no `when`. This customer holds no Pals Rewards membership, so her line earned no points (member_evt_points_earn posts only on a membership) and the reversal has nothing to take back: no member row can arise.
Owner of the damage credit: the base damage rule says 'the customer chooses a free replacement where replacement_allowed, or a refund'; taking the returnless refund is her own election, so she books it through the hand-over tool once the agent has fixed the amount. This departs from the blueprint summary's list of agent actions ('crediting damage'); base is frozen and the base rule itself gives the choice to the customer, so the departure is recorded here (audit O-7).
Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [6, 5, 6]} -> return refund 6, damage credit 5, fee refund 6.
Design thesis: 'refund my expedited shipping, it came late' -> the late-delivery fee refund (root) -> not worked out until the authorization received back for a Tailwise error carries its refund entry, and before it the declined damage report carries its returnless credit where the customer takes the money back -> both prerequisites are multi-factor computations -> the fee refund's error-settled share reads the units those writes settle.

[Problem-tree card]
Root order_ext_late_delivery_fee_refund. Edges, both value_input, gate error_units_settled, state form:
 -> order_ext_error_return_refund: "The fulfillment fee refund is not worked out until every return authorization on the order that has been received back for a Tailwise error carries its refund entry." (negated direction, as a refund desk states what a refund waits for). Four-point test: 'not ... until'; a record-visible state (a received authorization with a waived reason and a refund entry referring to it); no tool/id/code token; scope 'received back for a Tailwise error' — narrowed in round 2 so that every authorization the sentence waits on has a writer (audit O-6). Exactly one write books a return refund: the error-return refund.
 -> order_ext_returnless_damage_credit: "Before the fulfillment fee refund is worked out, every damage report on the order that was declined because the damaged item stays with the customer must carry its returnless damage credit wherever the customer takes the money back rather than a replacement." (affirmative 'before ... must'; round 2 adds the customer's-choice condition, audit O-6). Exactly one write books a damage credit: the returnless damage credit.
Derivation: sentence + records (5204560a-9999-4a8f-8bf3-e742ae6c2d9f received 2026-09-29, reason not_as_described, no refund; ea58d33a-edd0-4f14-8558-b6a8e166560d damaged, rejected, no credit) + the depended-on rules (the error-return refund settles 'the latest one on the order in status received' when its reason is a waived one; the damage rule defines 'a damage report on file' as a declined damaged request) -> one resolving action each; the customer's choice of money back is asked by the agent and answered by the persona.
False at frozen_time: order_events holds only 2ec4f076-2224-4812-adc6-2a5586d90f25 (line) and f3e43774-8f86-4c88-af9c-ea51f4c8b1dc (expedited fee).
Owner=user problem: the damage credit. Topological order: return refund (8) -> damage credit (10) -> fee refund (12); the prerequisites commute (order_uniqueness).
Deletion sensitivity (round-2 run): skip return refund -> 10.34; skip damage credit -> 10.34; skip both -> 8.84; gold 12.59.

[Base-invariant card]
Return refund: order_returns gates — completed_order (orders.status completed); return_window (time: anchor completed_date 2026-09-24 day 0; supplies 60 days; authorized 2026-09-26 = day 2; inclusive); units_not_over_refunded (0 + 1 <= 4); rma_received_in_time (time: anchor requested_on 2026-09-26; 14 days; received 2026-09-29 = day 3). order_evt_rewards: policy_scope. Overwrite: the unit-price sentence of order_returns for Tailwise-error returns (base 16.49, extended 27.74); deductions untouched and never apply to waived reasons.
Damage credit: order_damage_missing_claims — damage_window (time: completed 2026-09-24 day 0, damage_report_days 14; report 2026-09-26 day 2; frozen_time day 12), claim_units_not_over_refunded (1 + 1 <= 4). Choice replacement/refund and the returnless limit 25.00 inherited (23.99 <= 25.00). overwrite [] (base fixes no credit amount).
Fee refund: order_cancellation and order_delivery_promises (no gates). Overwrites: the late-delivery refund clause of order_delivery_promises (base 14.99, extended 12.59) — now the only policy naming that clause (audit O-4) — and the all-lines-error clause of order_returns. Inherited: a delay caused by the customer's absence is never late (delivery_attempts 0 is its record proxy).

[Business-object card]
Order a812b2d5-8ac4-47d6-9409-f7430d14dfd0, one line 2ec4f076-2224-4812-adc6-2a5586d90f25 (4 bowls, 18.99, coupon 10.00, billed 65.96), expedited fee f3e43774-8f86-4c88-af9c-ea51f4c8b1dc 14.99. 5204560a-9999-4a8f-8bf3-e742ae6c2d9f: 1 unit, not_as_described, in_store, received 2026-09-29 -> the return refund. ea58d33a-edd0-4f14-8558-b6a8e166560d: 1 unit, damaged, rejected 2026-09-26 -> the damage report. Fee refund correlates to f3e43774-8f86-4c88-af9c-ea51f4c8b1dc. Autoship d3542c9b-a3c8-4848-9446-0d38c0011b57: Litter & Bulk, active since 2023-03-08, 4-week cadence, shipment_seq continuous from enrollment (first seeded charge d28b5427-4c21-4a2a-8fe6-18567dce68eb on 2025-08-05 is shipment 32); 13 charges in the last 12 months (2025-08-05, 2025-09-02 and 2025-09-30 outside); claim refunds 2026-05-21 against the 2026-05-12 shipment (inside 12 months) and 2025-08-15 against the 2025-08-05 shipment d28b5427-4c21-4a2a-8fe6-18567dce68eb (outside — the near-miss of the basket valuation), each refunding the whole one-unit shipment 30.83 (merchandise after discount 20.89 + shipping 4.95 + heavy surcharge 4.99, as autoship_evt_shipment_claims gives for a claim covering every unit).
The single-line order makes the rule's 'the line charge' and compute's order-level line sums the same thing (audit O-3: an observation for multi-line orders, no effect here).

[Factor cards]
Return refund (6: 5 parameter, 1 method; expected 27.74, all-baseline 16.49): autoship_price_basis method 18.99 vs 16.49 (25.24); error_kind 3.00 (24.74); refund_wait 7 days -> 2.00 (25.74; near-miss: 6 days would be 1.00); return_dropoff in_store 1.00 (26.74); repeat_issue 1 other -> 1.25 (26.49); autoship_tenure 42 months -> 1.50 (26.24).
Damage credit (5: 4 parameter, 1 method; expected 23.99, all-baseline 16.49): prompt_report_value method, multi-source (2 days AND 13 shipments) -> 18.99 (21.49); damage_severity 0.25 -> 1.00 (22.99); late_arrival 3 days -> 1.50 (22.49); multi_issue 1 other -> 1.00 (22.99); subscriber_tenure 1.50 (22.49).
Fee refund (6: 5 parameter, 1 method; expected 12.59, all-baseline 3.75): lateness 3 days -> 0.40 (10.34); error_settled 2/4 -> 0.25 (8.84); repeat_issue_count 2 -> 0.10 (11.09); autoship_patron 0.05 (11.84); basket_value 75.96 -> 0.04 (11.99); basket_valuation method, multi-source (claim refund 2026-05-21 AND 13 shipments) -> basket valued before its coupon, 75.96 instead of 65.96 (11.99; near-miss: the 2025-08-15 claim is outside 12 months). The valuation tiers apply different formulas (amount billed + discounts / amount billed + half the discounts / amount billed), the same pattern as the return refund's unit-value method.
Task floors: multi-source 2 (prompt_report_value, basket_valuation); cross-difficulty 6 (autoship_price_basis, autoship_tenure, prompt_report_value, subscriber_tenure, autoship_patron, basket_valuation).

[Rule <-> compute]
Forward quotations in compute_basis. Reverse sweep: 'the latest one on the order in status received, by received date' -> LATEST(date_field=received_on, status=received) (round 2: the rule now states exactly this, and the waived-reason test is a separate sentence matched by the result gate — audit O-2); 'rounded half up to the cent' -> RND; 'added together and rounded ... once at the end' -> one RND; 'Where that sum is above returnless_refund_max_usd, no returnless damage credit' -> result 0 branch; 'never more than the fulfillment fee charged less the fulfillment fee already refunded' -> MN; 'other than redelivery fees' -> subtraction of the redelivery SUM; 'no failed delivery attempt on record' -> delivery_attempts == 0; basket valuation tiers -> basket_billed + basket_discounts / + half / as billed.

[Persona]
Celeste Marchetti, brisk designer: volunteers only the late expedited delivery and the 14.99 she paid; mobile (locator), email (credential), ZIP spare. Passive: lets Tailwise settle other things first, always picks money back over a replacement and completes the handed-over refund with the agent's figures, asks once if the shipping refund is under 14.99, ends when the shipping refund is issued.

[Seed rationale]
customers, orders, order_events (line, fee), order_return_requests (received error return; declined damage report), autoship_subscriptions + autoship_events (12-month shipments, claims, tenure). Removing 5204560a-9999-4a8f-8bf3-e742ae6c2d9f removes the return refund problem and the repeat/multi-issue tiers; removing ea58d33a-edd0-4f14-8558-b6a8e166560d removes the damage problem. Removing the Autoship subscription and its ledger drops seven factors to their fall-through — autoship_price_basis and autoship_tenure (return refund 23.74), prompt_report_value and subscriber_tenure (damage credit 19.99), autoship_patron, basket_valuation and, through the valuation, basket_value (fee refund 11.24) — round-2 run (corrects the round-1 'five', audit T1-3). No automatic clause ignites.

[Standard solution]
Locate, verify, read order, ledger, authorizations, Autoship subscription and ledger; refund the received authorization (27.74); ask replacement vs refund for the cracked bowl, hand over the returnless refund (23.99); refund 12.59 of the expedited fee.

[Verification — round 2]
Authoring evaluator on the handling-time DB: 27.74 / 23.99 / 12.59; the prerequisites in either order give the same values and billed total 29.22. Gates (task 1, round 2): REPLAY OK, COMPUTE OK, EXTENDED OK, SOLVABILITY OK, GROUNDING OK (difficulty-wide block re-run at close).

[Draft from the visible context]
The fee-refund rule names both waits; the authorization list shows one received and unrefunded with a waived reason, one declined damaged; their rules give 27.74 and 23.99 (the latter after the customer picks money back); the fee rule then gives 12.59 on the updated ledger. Same objects, order and amounts as gold.

[Revisions]
Round 1: basket_share_mid moved off a half-cent tie; tool/seed fixes shared with task 0.
Round 2 (audit 1.md / _difficulty.md):
- T1-1 / G-1 (claims multiplier labelled method): the multiplier is removed; the same evidence (Autoship claim refunds AND shipments in 12 months) now drives basket_valuation, an honest method choosing how the basket is valued; basket_mid_usd set to 70. Fee refund 13.85 -> 12.59.
- T1-2 (claim row with no claimable shipment): the 2025-08-05 shipment d28b5427-4c21-4a2a-8fe6-18567dce68eb is seeded and the 2025-08-15 claim refers to it (day 10, inside the 30-day damaged window); both claim refunds now carry the full one-unit refund 30.83 with shipping and heavy surcharge; shipment_seq made continuous from enrollment and the subscription billed total recomputed (billed total 1387.35 = shipments up to seq 47 x 30.83 less two claim refunds).
- T1-3 (false 'five factors'): corrected to the seven factors above with the run figures.
- Observation fixes: unfilled '{RB}' placeholder in the damage-credit quantity tracing filled; P3 rule matches its LATEST read (O-2); P5 waits made conditional (O-6).
- Propagated: gold argument step 12, computations[2], tracing (steps 8, 10, 12), prerequisite_closure sentences/conditions/load-bearing figures, solvability business effect, evaluation_criteria[6].
user_scenario: You are Celeste Marchetti, a brisk freelance graphic designer in Denver who likes to get to the point. You call Tailwise about one thing: you paid $14.99 for expedited shipping on an order of four ceramic slow-feeder cat bowls placed on September 17, it was supposed to arrive on Monday, September 21, and it only showed up on Thursday, September 24. You want the expedited shipping charge refunded to your card. Nobody else had to be home for it, the box simply came late. You do not know the order number by heart; you offer your mobile number, 3035550518, so they can find you. When asked to confirm your identity you give your email, celeste.marchetti@yahoo.com, and if they want one more detail your billing ZIP code is 80206. You do not bring up anything else about the order on your own and you do not quote any amounts other than the $14.99 you paid for shipping. If the agent tells you that something else on the order has to be settled on Tailwise's side before the shipping refund can be worked out, you tell them to go ahead. If the agent asks you to choose between a replacement and getting your money back for anything on this order, you always choose the money back; when the agent hands that over for you to complete yourself, you complete it with exactly the details and amount the agent gives you and read back the confirmation. When the agent tells you how much of the shipping charge is being refunded, if it is less than the $14.99 you paid you ask once whether that is right, and you accept the answer without suggesting a figure. Once the agent confirms the shipping refund has been issued, you thank them and hang up.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.order_id: a812b2d5-8ac4-47d6-9409-f7430d14dfd0. Basis: the order the customer describes (expedited, placed 2026-09-17); unique.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.original_event_id: f3e43774-8f86-4c88-af9c-ea51f4c8b1dc. Basis: the rule books the refund 'against the fulfillment fee charge with that fee's kind'; the only fee charge is f3e43774-8f86-4c88-af9c-ea51f4c8b1dc. Unique.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.fee_kind: expedited. Basis: the rule says 'with that fee's kind' and the docstring 'copied from the fee charge being refunded'; the fee charge's fee_kind is expedited. none, shipping, same_day_delivery, freight and redelivery are other kinds and do not match the charge.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount_usd: 12.59 = RND(MN(14.99 - 0.00, 14.99 x 0.84), 2), evaluated after both prerequisite writes. Lateness 0.40: 3 days late (>= 3, < 5). Error-settled 0.25: 1 unit refunded on the not_as_described authorization + 1 unit damage-credited = 2 >= 0.5 x 4. Repeat-issue 0.10: two Tailwise-error authorizations on the order. Autoship-patron 0.05: 42 months. Basket 0.04: basket valuation — one Autoship claim refund in 12 months (2026-05-21; 2025-08-15 outside) AND 13 shipments >= 6, so the basket is valued before its coupon: 65.96 + 10.00 = 75.96 (>= 70, < 100). Sum 0.84. Order completed late, no failed delivery attempt, late_delivery_fee_refund true for Expedited.

edges.condition: No return authorization on the order with a reason in return_fee_waived_reasons is left in status received: each such received authorization has its return refund entry on the order ledger referring to it, and its units count among the error-settled units.
edges.policy_source: The fulfillment fee refund is not worked out until every return authorization on the order that has been received back for a Tailwise error carries its refund entry.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The not_as_described authorization is in status received (item back at a store on 2026-09-29) and the order ledger holds no return refund for it: the line charge and the expedited fee are the only rows.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The return refund books a 27.74 order_return_refund of 1 unit with reason not_as_described against the line and the authorization, which becomes refunded; error-settled units rise from 0 (or 1) to 1 (or 2).

edges.condition: Each declined damage report on the order whose customer takes the money back has a damage credit entry on the order ledger for its line, so the damaged units count among the error-settled units.
edges.policy_source: Before the fulfillment fee refund is worked out, every damage report on the order that was declined because the damaged item stays with the customer must carry its returnless damage credit wherever the customer takes the money back rather than a replacement.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The damaged request of 2026-09-26 was declined (status rejected) because the bowl stays with the customer, and the ledger holds no damage credit (and no replacement) for the line.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The customer's returnless refund books a 23.99 order_damage_credit of 1 unit against the line; error-settled units rise by 1.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel and commute: the return refund's computation reads only the received authorization, the line charge, the authorization counts by reason (any status) and the Autoship records, none of which the damage credit writes; the damage credit's computation reads the declined damaged request, the line charge, the order dates, the authorization counts and the Autoship records, none of which the return refund changes (it only moves the received authorization to refunded, while the counts are by reason in any status). Authoring run: refund-then-credit and credit-then-refund give 27.74 and 23.99 in both orders, the same rows (ids are content hashes of the arguments, dates are frozen_time), and the order billed total 29.22 either way; the fee refund is 12.59 after both.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the return refund, error-settled units are 1 of 4 (only the damage credit), the error-settled share falls from 0.25 to 0.10 and the fee refund is 10.34 instead of 12.59; the 27.74 return refund row is also missing and the authorization stays received.

Without the damage credit, error-settled units are 1 of 4 (only the return refund), the share falls to 0.10 and the fee refund is 10.34 instead of 12.59; the 23.99 damage credit row is also missing. Skipping both gives 8.84.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The customer only asks for the expedited shipping charge back because the order came late. She never mentions the returned bowl, the cracked bowl, a refund other than the shipping charge, or anything to be sorted out first; her choice of money back over a replacement, and her agreement to let Tailwise settle other things, are passive replies given only after the agent raises them.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: refund_order_fulfillment_fee_03b15c6d books the fee refund it is given whether or not the order has return refunds or damage credits; refund_error_return_9d87fcb3 and accept_returnless_damage_refund_2d82d69e likewise book whatever they are given. None of them reads the authorizations' state to refuse, and none returns an error or a hint (see task_tools.py).
